options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Completion Goal
options.doc:
Choose what counts as completing the world:
- Complete Any Ending: reach Ending Reached (default behavior).
- Complete Any Ending W/ All Side Quests: reach Ending Reached and have
  logical access to every included SIDE_QUEST / DLC_SIDE location.
- Complete Only Phantom Liberty Questline: complete PL's main questline.
  This mode implies Phantom Liberty DLC for world generation and disables
  district token restrictions to keep the pool aligned to PL checks.

choices.label: Complete Any Ending W All Side Quests

options.doc_fr:
Choisissez ce qui compte pour compléter le monde:
- Complete Any Ending: atteint Fin Atteint (comportement par défaut).
- Compléter n'importe quelle fin W/ All Side Quests: atteindre Terminer Atteint et avoir un accès logique à chaque emplacement SIDE QUEST / DLC SIDE inclus.
- Complete Only Phantom Liberty Questline : complète la ligne principale de PL.
  Ce mode implique Phantom Liberty DLC pour la génération mondiale et désactive les restrictions de jeton de district pour garder le pool aligné aux contrôles PL.

options.name: District Restriction Type
options.doc:
Choose the major-district restriction behavior:
- None: District tokens are not placed and the client will not enforce district locks.
- Require District Token: Selected districts require their access token.

Defaults to None: gating every major district behind its own always-required
Access Token can leave too few always-reachable locations to place all of
those tokens, causing generation failures. Opt in (and consider disabling
a few districts below) once you've verified generation succeeds for your
other settings.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez le comportement de restriction des grands districts :
- None: Les jetons de district ne sont pas placés et le client ne fera pas respecter les serrures de district.
- Require District Token: Les districts sélectionnés ont besoin de leur jeton d'accès.

Defaults to None: En d'autres termes, il n'y a pas assez d'endroits accessibles pour placer tous ces jetons, ce qui cause des défaillances de génération. Optez pour (et envisagez de désactiver quelques districts ci-dessous) une fois que vous avez vérifié la génération réussit pour vos autres paramètres.

options.name: District Tokens from Other Worlds
options.doc:
When district restrictions are active and this is enabled in a multiworld,
active district and subdistrict access tokens are added to non_local_items
and cannot be placed on your own checks.

No effect when district restriction type is None, in solo seeds, or when
the PL-only completion goal disables district restrictions.

Cannot Equip - Nothing will allow you to use the selected weapon types during this run
Require Multiworld Item - You will need to acquire an item from the multiworld to use the selected weapon types during this run
